main_body: desert mud-brick building with flat terraced roof and turquoise dome
top_band: light sandy tan roof surface with parapet and dome from row 3 to row 33
evidence: Rows 3-33 show a clear foreshortened flat roof with a recessed parapet and dome sitting on it; row 32-33 forms a bright front-edge cornice, rows 34-36 form a dark eave shadow, and rows 34-63 show the vertical mud-brick south wall with inset arched door and window.

style.evidence: While the palette ramps and dark material outlines are appropriate, the surface craft is noticeably flatter and more mechanical than the Beodeul references: the dome base (rows 18-21) consists of two large solid flat-filled blocks, the bricks are large uniform rectangles with minimal speckling and thick flat mortar bands, and the door planks are flat vertical strips.
